row.evidence: LastPass's pricing comparison marks "Directory integrations" (automated account provisioning with Entra ID, Okta, OneLogin, Google Workspace, AD) as not included in Teams and included in Business and Business Max.
row.notes: Prices corrected on 2026-10-08: LastPass injects plan prices with a script and blocks automated browsers, so only the Teams price stated in text on its own compare page ($4/user/month) is confirmed; the Business price is not, so no multiplier is computed. Directory integrations (user provisioning) are Business and Business Max only. Status unchanged (gated: SCIM/directory integrations start at Business, one tier above Teams). Price change vs June: the pricing page loads prices from LastPass's product catalog, which lists Teams at $51/user/yr ($4.25/u/mo) rather than the ~$4 recorded in June (the Teams-vs-Business compare page still says $4/user/month; see conflicts); Business is $84/yr ($7/u/mo), Business Max (formerly "Business + Add-Ons") $132/yr ($11/u/mo). Multiplier 7/4.25 = 1.6 (was 1.8). Federated login (SSO into LastPass with your IdP) is Business+. LastPass's support centre (support.lastpass.com, Zoomin backend) and the Enterprise API docs (lastpass.com/enterprise_apidoc.php, login required) could not be loaded, so SCIM endpoint details, deprovisioning behaviour and API endpoints are unverified. The June note about "SSO portal for 3 apps" refers to LastPass acting as an SSO provider for other apps, not SAML into LastPass.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: Grid flags (directory integrations, federated login, SIEM = no) read from the comparison grid image alt text. Compare page says $4/user/month (see conflicts).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Directory integrations, federated login and SIEM integrations = yes in the comparison grid (image alt text). SSO into 3 apps via LastPass as IdP.

operations.notes: Okta OIN page markup marks Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked.

scim.notes: SCIM is described as IdP-specific endpoints (Entra ID, Okta, OneLogin, PingOne/PingFederate); whether a generic SCIM 2.0 endpoint is documented could not be checked because the support centre did not load.

capabilities.notes: Only "control user provisioning with the LastPass API" is stated publicly.

audit_log_api.notes: SIEM integrations (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel) are Business+; no public audit-log API reference was loadable.

okta.notes: OIN markup marks SWA and SCIM checked (SAML/OIDC unchecked); federated login with Okta is described in the overview text.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial for LastPass exists in the Entra SaaS-app TOC; facts are from LastPass's own pages.

google.notes: "Google Directory Integration" per LastPass; whether it is SCIM or a LastPass-run API sync is not stated on loadable pages.

onelogin.notes: From LastPass's directory-integration page; OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: LastPass AD Connector (on-prem Active Directory client); Google Directory Integration; PingOne/PingFederate
fallbacks.notes: docs_public false: the Enterprise API documentation redirects to a LastPass login, and help-centre articles are rendered through a backend that rejects unauthenticated requests.

conflicts.text: Teams price: the Teams-vs-Business compare page says "$4/user/month", while the product catalog that fills the pricing page lists Teams at $51/user/yr ($4.25/user/month). The catalog (pricing page) value is used.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, auth/token expiry, endpoints and attribute list: documented only in support.lastpass.com articles that could not be loaded (e.g. faq_scim_provisioning, Set_Up_Okta_Integration, Set_Up_Azure_Active_Directory_Integration).
Whether SCIM deprovisioning disables or deletes the LastPass user, and whether it frees the licence.
Whether a generic SCIM 2.0 endpoint exists for any SCIM client.
Plan requirement and endpoint list for the LastPass Enterprise (provisioning) API; docs require login.
Whether an audit/event-reporting API exists outside the SIEM integrations, and its plan.
Whether SSO (federated login) must be configured before SCIM.
Entra gallery, Google, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue listings could not be verified on the IdP sites.
